title: Store Product — React.js
description: E-commerce application built with React.js and Vite. Consumes a Fake API (FakeStoreAPI) to display products dynamically. Includes category filtering, shopping cart management, and a fully responsive interface.

title: IT Intervention Management
description: Web application for managing and tracking IT intervention requests at the Agence Urbaine de Laâyoune. Built with Object-Oriented PHP (OOP) following MVC architecture. Features two interfaces (Client & Admin), request tracking, statistics, and report generation.

title: Todo App — Full Stack
description: Multi-tier task management application with a secure Laravel REST API (Sanctum) and a React frontend. Features token-based authentication, full CRUD operations, advanced filtering by status, keyword search and date ranges, inline status updates, and light/dark theme.
